quote.text: If it pleases the gods, so be it.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood: Embrace the natural unfolding of your child's growth, knowing that each stage is part of a larger destiny.
  • Parenthood: Accept the unpredictability of parenthood as a divine plan; learn to trust in the process even when outcomes differ from your expectations.
  • Leadership: Recognize that events may occur beyond your control; lead with humility by understanding that the destiny of your team is also influenced by forces beyond human design.
  • Leadership: Cultivate the strength to adapt and act wisely, accepting that sometimes things unfold as they must, guiding your decisions with both acceptance and strategic insight.
  • Product Management: Understand that every iteration or outcome is part of a grand design, helping you remain resilient and open to learning from both success and setbacks.
  • Product Management: Integrate this acceptance into your strategy; let it remind you that flexibility and a calm mindset can drive innovation, even when product trajectories are shaped by unforeseen circumstances.
